design.familySeparation: People/project/origin families stay on one side of development/heldout boundary. Distinct heldout works may share creator/project. Only canonical case/origin-equivalent duplicates collapse quota. Recall/audit overlap permitted by sampling design.
design.auditTiming: WP03 freezes selection procedure only; actual >=100 independent admitted audit and actual frame/interval occur in WP24.
design.precisionPopulation: Audited admitted items only; candidate prediction precision separate without E02 gate. Published recall unavailable unless publication observations explicitly supplied.
design.metricCohorts: Explicit admitted-audit, recall-roster, candidate-evaluation; overlap allowed; each denominator scoped independently.

rootReviewCorrections.finding: Initial validator required actual admitted audit data before WP03 freeze, creating WP03/admission dependency cycle.
rootReviewCorrections.resolution: Replaced actual audit sampling requirement with versioned frame definition, selection method, interval rule, minimum100 and procedure receipt; no actual audit rows needed for preparation readiness. E02 threshold/minimum unchanged.

rootReviewCorrections.finding: Initial all-five-partition separation and whole-creator/project quota collapse were stricter than handoff.
rootReviewCorrections.resolution: Restrict split leakage check to development/heldout. Permit distinct works with shared creator/project within heldout; permit designed recall/audit overlap. Canonical origin-equivalent copies still collapse. Statistical clustering reported separately.

rootReviewCorrections.finding: Initial precision counted all predicted positives, allowing unadmitted model proposals to reach an E02-looking numerical gate.
rootReviewCorrections.resolution: Admission precision uses admitted rows. Candidate precision has no E02 gate; ambiguous admitted items never true positives. Captured/admitted/published recall separate; missing publication observations return unavailable.

terraReviewCorrections.finding: Current exposure checked only exact heldout case IDs; alternative exposed family member evaded freshness guard.
terraReviewCorrections.resolution: Compare all known exposed case family/subject/native/byte keys to heldout; refuse unknown exposure IDs; regression passes.

terraReviewCorrections.finding: Candidate-only zero-error observations could imply critical identity gate passed.
terraReviewCorrections.resolution: Gate always false/not_evaluated in this preparation helper; counts remain descriptive until qualified external public-output audit.

terraReviewCorrections.finding: Mixed metric rows lacked explicit audit versus recall membership, allowing denominator contamination.
terraReviewCorrections.resolution: Required strict per-row admitted-audit/recall-roster/candidate-evaluation membership with allowed overlap. Each metric filters its own cohort; mixed-cohort regression and missing-cohort refusal pass. Cluster effects assessed per metric cohort.

terraReviewCorrections.finding: Indirect family exposure via intermediate non-heldout case evaded direct-key comparison.
terraReviewCorrections.resolution: Use full connected components for exposure/split/history. Resolve origin-equivalent canonical counts across intermediates. Retained three-case failure and regressions for transitive exposure, split leakage and duplicate quota.

terraReviewCorrections.finding: admitted-audit membership with admitted:false silently omitted selected rows.
terraReviewCorrections.resolution: Reject inconsistent audit membership; admitted means admission at defined sampling observation. Later withdrawn/unresolved item remains admitted-at-selection, with conservative truth/publication status, never denominator deletion. Test added.
